newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels stocks ends lower after Bekaert sell off.
newsitem.headline: Brussels stocks ends lower after Bekaert sell off.

text.p: 1540 GMT - Belgian shares closed lower with the Bel-20 leading share index pulled down by a major sell off in steel cord and wire maker Bekaert, weakness on Wall Street and disappointing U.S. housing data.
* The Bel-20 share index slipped down 0.6 percent or 11.16 points to 1,849.03 with volume of Belgian shares changing hands a moderate 2.6 billion francs.
* Bekaert fell 13.43 percent or 19,825 francs after the company said it expected a provision for a 1.6 billion franc restructuring programme to take 1996 current profits near to breakeven.
